title: WeChat Pay in China - how foreigners can pay
text: Since 2024 WeChat Pay works with foreign cards, making life in Zhangjiajie much easier. Download WeChat before your trip, link a Visa/Mastercard in the Wallet section and top up (limit 1,000 yuan per day). Used everywhere - shops, taxis, even street vendors.

title: How to buy tickets and skip the queues
text: National park entry is 225 yuan (valid 4 days!) plus 65 yuan for internal transport - 290 yuan total. Buy via WeChat/Alipay, at the ticket office with passport, or through Trip.com. Arrive by 7 am and use the Wulingyuan gate to avoid morning crowds.

title: Where Avatar was filmed
text: James Cameron drew inspiration from Zhangjiajie for the planet Pandora. The Southern Sky Column was officially renamed Avatar Hallelujah Mountain in 2010. Key spots: Hallelujah Pillar, First Bridge Under Heaven (357 m) and the Back Garden panorama.

title: Golden Whip Stream - the most scenic trail
text: A 7.5 km trail along a mountain stream through a canyon of quartzite pillars. This is a must-do route, taking 2.5-3 hours one-way. Flat path with minimal elevation, clear stream, wooden bridges and curious wild macaques along the way.

title: 99 Bends to Tianmen Heaven's Gate
text: The Tongtian Avenue is an 11 km mountain road with 99 hairpin turns, leading up to Tianmen's Heaven's Gate - a natural rock arch 131 m high. Riding the special park buses along this legendary serpentine is an unforgettable 25-30 minute experience.
